eventos.texto: Good morning, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hi, I went over on my ankle yesterday. It's swollen and walking hurts. Can someone see me soon?
Por lo que cuenta (el tobillo), lo encamina a traumatología
Entiende cuándo la quiere: lo antes posible
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
Laura Ruiz Gomez born the 14th of September 1978.

Ofrece el lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00 con la Dra. Núria Ferrer en Arenal Norte
Thank you, Laura, I have your record here. The earliest I have is Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dra. Núria Ferrer at Arenal Norte. Shall I book that for you?
